controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from Hubble's spectrum of the star. The disc is unresolved; its darker edge is measured from transits of its planet.
controls.notes: The colour of the Hubble Space Telescope's calibrated STIS spectrum of HD 209458, a CALSPEC flux standard. No resolved image of the surface is cast; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.
